        _ = 0 := by simp [hz]
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hc
    exact ⟨w, fun k => beta.repr w k, j, hwW, (beta.sum_repr w).symm, hw0, hj⟩

  apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem beta).2
